name: Four-floor 909 pump
desc: Harvested stage groove: 909 four-on-the-floor with clap on 2&4, offbeat open hats, ghost-note 16th hats, and a rotating uzu cowbell euclid. Hat filter breathes over 16 cycles, ply fills punctuate every 4/8-bar phrase end, crash gates every 4th cycle at peak.

gain.doc: kick level, other layers scale from it

fill.doc: ply multiplier for phrase-end hat fills (integer)

code.full: stack(s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}).shape(.2).lpf(3200), s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*.62).room(.35).delay(.12).delaytime(.25).delayfeedback(.15), s("[~ oh]*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*.5).lpf(5000).pan(.55), s("hh*16").bank("RolandTR909").gain("[.45 .15 .3 .12]*4").lpf(sine.range(3500, ${hcut}).slow(16)).pan(sine.range(.4, .6).slow(7)).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(${fill})), s("cb(2,8,<0 2 4 6>)").gain(.26).pan(.7)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}).shape(.25).lpf(3500), s("~ cp ~ [cp cp]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*.66).room(.35).delay(.12).delaytime(.25).delayfeedback(.18), s("[~ oh]*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*.55).lpf(6000).pan(.6), s("hh*16").bank("RolandTR909").gain("[.5 .2 .35 .15]*4").lpf(sine.range(4500, ${hcut}).slow(8)).pan(sine.range(.35, .65).slow(7)).every(4, x=>x.ply(${fill})), s("cb(3,8,<0 2 4 6>)").gain(.3).pan(.7), s("cr ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.32).mask("<1 0 0 0>")).orbit(1).play()
